method: Built-in image_gen; transparent source sprites mechanically registered to working gate hinges.

prompts.gate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game gate-leaf sprite. Reference image is STYLE AND MATERIAL only: match the user's original weathered palisade, its warm golden cut oak, dark bark, green moss, thin rope lashings and crisp hand-painted RPG outlines. Create ONE single hinged wooden gate leaf, viewed perfectly straight-on as a rectangular riggable sprite, approximately as wide as tall. A rustic camp gate of five uneven split-log upright slats with narrow irregular spaces, two rough horizontal half-log rails, one diagonal timber brace. Small dark iron hinge pins at LEFT edge, simple rope-wrapped pull at RIGHT edge. Modest timber thickness matching the reference, worn splintered wood, a few chipped upper ends, no chunky castle framing, no big iron bands, no ornate fittings, no metal ring. Should clearly belong with the battered original wall. ONE panel only, no posts, no surrounding fence, no terrain, no scenery. Entire gate fits inside frame with margins. True transparent background, no glow, no shadow island, no text or labels.
prompts.post: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D camp gatepost sprite. Reference is STYLE AND MATERIAL only. Create ONE modest gatepost matching exactly this original worn wooden camp palisade: a single weathered oak trunk, uneven pointed split top, dark warm bark and golden cut timber, two thin simple rope lashings, a short rear diagonal timber foot brace, a tiny mossy contact patch at the foot. Same hand-painted outlined top-down RPG camera as reference; tops and front visible. Do not make the trunk thicker or grander than one of the original wall's posts. No wide metal bands or rings, no castle pier, no massive foundation. One complete upright post centred in portrait composition with generous margins on all sides. Actual transparent background; no scenery, backdrop, glow, writing or ground island.
